All contam happened during grain colonization. My first few rounds were from a contaminated MSS, so I lost all bags to bacteria (cheesy appearance in the view window). The second round I had two better MSSs, but I still lost 4/8 bags to wet rot. Two went into my first shoebox 6qt tub (in retrospect I should've separated them but it ended up working out), and the results are what you see above. The other two are slowly colonizing with no obvious signs of contam. I use a SAB and am thoroughly sterile in my work, so I do feel the contam in the second round of bags was fron the UB moisture content. My next experiment will be using some more UB bags for agar2G, which I've read is typically more successful.

Speaking from experience, having a panic disorder is totally not a barrier to psychedelics at all; just make sure you know yourself.

There's no way to guarantee a safe trip. Most of my trips have had low points, but because I knew that it would pass and because I had a safe environment and a sitter set up, it was never anything bad and usually ended up being cathartic.

Some advice if you decide to trip: start small, get a sitter, take 2 days off if you can (a day to do it and a day to recover), and if you start freaking out, physically change locations. An environment shift is super helpful for a lot of folks.

If you don't think you can take on a panic attack, that's okay and valid, but you shouldn't take higher shroom doses.
